No supplement or nonoccurring event date is invented. No user/study/private/selftest/manually adapted oracle is used. All personal own-name/own-account/control conditions are stipulated true; no PSM or fertiliser is used and the natural fodder is sufficient.
probes.expected_derivation: Each5ha Alm has4distinct cattle×1RGVE×all61credited days, so4eligibleha perAlm. All3 stockdensities4/5=0.8 and occupancy61days; sum12eligibleha below200, factor1. Three source tariffs yield720EUR. No cross-Alm dayallocation, pending approval, sanction percentage or A07 global-vs-local-min question determines this known component.
